_comment: TEMPLATE with an empty content set. Sentinel-path -> area mapping for the contract-critic skip system. A contract belongs to the UNION of every matching area (not first-match-wins). Skip is offered only when ALL areas the contract touches are skip-eligible. Patterns use the same '...' (multi-segment) and '*' (single-segment) wildcard syntax as concept-gate.py 'Files to touch' entries -- see .claude/scripts/_contract_files.matches_path. To populate: add one key per area with a stable lowercase slug; patterns should be lowercase forward-slash paths that match what data-architect typically writes in 'Files to touch'.
_seed_adjacency_comment: Each area MAY carry an optional `seed_adjacency: [<slug>, ...]` array listing adjacent areas the cross-area scanner cannot derive from CodeGraph / journal / mechanism signals. DO NOT enumerate every adjacency -- that re-creates the hand-curated graph the cross-area system is designed to avoid. The seed list weight is +1 so it cannot dominate the codegraph signal; seeds still respect the top-3 cap and the threshold. Read by .claude/scripts/cross_area_scan.py.

<area-slug>.description: <one sentence: what belongs in this area, and whether it is safety-critical>
